items.title: Extension of scalars of an injective module along a polynomial ring has injective amplitude in two degrees
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file dualizing.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that extending scalars of an injective module along a polynomial ring in one variable gives an object of injective amplitude concentrated in degrees zero and one (author lemma at source lines 590-596, label lemma-injective-dimension-over-polynomial-ring). The proof (source lines 598-613) exhibits an explicit two-term resolution by injective modules over the polynomial ring, checking exactness and surjectivity of the second map by a product decomposition and injectivity of the two terms by the direct-sum and mapping-into-injective statements (proof lines 598-612). The explicit resolution is the substance. H3.
